entries.name: The Stieff Company year mark, 1901
entries.means: Year mark of The Stieff Company for 1901, on hollowware (sterling).
entries.system: From 1901 the Stieff Company struck a year symbol on its sterling hollowware beside its trademark. 1901-1925 are shapes (a circled number to 1916, then geometric marks, several years with two alternatives); 1926-1935 are varied shapes, several years given as two alternatives joined by 'or'; 1936-1958 are the letters A to Z skipping I, Q and V; from 1959 the mark is a number counting from 1 (1959) up. After the 1979 merger with S. Kirk & Son the table appears under the Kirk Stieff entry.

entries.name: Tiffany & Co. mark used 1875-1891
entries.looks_like: M (Moore) in the sterling mark: TIFFANY & CO. MAKERS, STERLING-SILVER, 925-1000, then the letter M.
entries.means: Tiffany & Co. struck this 1875-1891, on sterling silver (hollowware and flatware).
entries.date_note: Kovels prints this mark with no dates, so the years rest on Rainwater alone; the letter and mark agree. Rainwater's text says the factory's silverware bore an M after the 1868 incorporation and that the incumbent president's surname initial was added after Edward C. Moore died in 1891; the printed mark says 'Used 1875-91'. Kovels also shows the 'STERLING M PAT.' stamp and a framed M mark, undated.
entries.system: Tiffany struck no different symbol each year. Its sterling mark carries a letter, the surname initial of the company's president, which changes with the president, so it dates a piece to a span of years: M 1875-91, T 1891-1902, C 1902-07, M 1907-38, and from 1938 a mark with M beside a five-digit number (Rainwater's printed spans). Pattern and order numbers beside MAKERS are not dates. Tiffany also added one-off exposition marks for 1893, 1900 and 1901.

disagreements.says: 1868 vs 1875: Rainwater's text puts the M after the 1868 incorporation, its printed mark says 'Used 1875-91'; the printed span is used.

entries.system: Tiffany struck no different symbol each year. entries.series: Whiting Manufacturing Co. (Whiting M.F.G. Co.) year marks, 1905-1924
entries.system: Rainwater prints a table headed 'Whiting M.F.G. Co. Year Marks' giving one small symbol for each year from 1905 to 1924, shown beside the lion and 'Whiting' trademark on sterling. It does not say which wares carried them or why they ended in 1924.
